notes.title: New Miner Multiplayer Game
notes.notes:
In this new adventure with new playable characters, you will be in Hoverpelago to try to do the perfect Hoversurf, this new game introduces Minerverse to the online multiplayer world, lots of fun with your friends playing together !!!

notes.title: Miner is Back !!!
notes.notes:
This new Miner game will change the adventure a lot, as always we will have a great adventure very fun, it will be a 3d platform game with physics, you will be able to use the new skill of our heroes, bubblegum rope, Miner will now count on the help of Psycho Bunny to make the adventure much more fun, with extreme difficulty this new game needs all your powers of a true gamer !!!
